description: This file is part of a larger ASP.NET Core project and defines the 'Details' feature for handling article detail retrieval. It includes a query object, a validator for the query, and a handler that fetches article data from the database based on a slug, throwing an exception if not found.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Represents the request for article details, identified by a slug.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the slug in the query is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the request to retrieve the article by slug, interacting with the database context.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches an article by slug; throws a not found exception if the article does not exist.
